verdict.rationale: Replit documents a design-to-app path: a Replit Design frame or template can be turned into a functional website by Agent while preserving its visual design. Designs made in its visual design space can also be applied directly to the app. However, nothing in the evidence shows importing a Figma file or any external existing design; the implemented designs originate inside Replit. Missing for 10: Figma file import, import of external or existing design files, independent or hands-on corroboration of design fidelity.

support.subject: As a designer, I can import a Figma file or existing design and have the builder implement it

citations.quote: Start from a Replit Design template, turn the selected frame into a functional website with Agent, test it in Preview, and publish a live URL.
Build this selected template as a functional website. Preserve its visual design and make its navigation and contact actions work.
Introducing a new space that allows you to explore and tweak designs visually, and then apply them directly to your app.
